name: The Orphan
summary: An orphanage worker asks you to find Sergeant Danneth at Nethergarde Keep. He may be the surviving family of Randal, an orphan in their care.

sections.title: A Family Search
sections.body: Randal may have family at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. You are asked to find Sergeant Danneth and, if you can, persuade him to come for his nephew. The two may never have met, but the orphanage hopes Randal can be with family.

sections.title: Word at the Keep
sections.body: At Nethergarde Keep, you learn that Danneth has been missing for days. His squad was ambushed near Serpent's Spine, and no body was found. His chances of survival are poor.

faq.answer: Randal is an orphan who may have a surviving family member.
Danneth is a soldier stationed at Nethergarde Keep and may be Randal's uncle.
Danneth is stationed at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: Why are you looking for Danneth?
faq.answer: The orphanage has heard that Danneth may be Randal's family and hopes he can take his nephew in.
